author: Mark Gardyna
title: Toddler hit, killed by Amtrak train in Springfield - NewsBreak
text:
By Mark Gardyna Photojournalist: Rick Mora ,
4 hours ago SPRINGFIELD, Mass. (WGGB/WSHM) - Around 6 p.m. on Wednesday evening, officials responded to a report of a 3-year-old child was hit by a train nearby Emily Street. According to Springfield Police spokesperson Ryan Walsh, around 6:15 p.m. Springfield Police responded to the 0-100 block of Emily Street for the report of a toddler being struck by a train. She was taken to Baystate Medical Center where she later died from her injuries. Read full article
